description: Check pump.fun wallets by address: what each has been since day one, its class by rule (winner: took out 10+ SOL and 1% more than it put in over 20+ coin-weeks; net_loser: put in 50+ SOL more than it took out; bot: a sniper (20+ coins bought in their create block, half or more of its new coins) or 1,500+ trades a day; supply_seller: took out 1.5x what it put in, 100 SOL or more; new: no record before the mint you name, or before today; none: no rule fits, usually too young for them), why (the rule it met, with its numbers) and the numbers behind it: pnl_sol, put_in, took_out, coins, first_seen, recent (its pace). For: who is buying this coin, is this wallet a bot, a wallet's PnL, a holder check on the top buyers. Up to 50 addresses a call. $0.01 a call, USDC on Solana over x402, or a free key.

mint.description: optional: the coin they are buying; a wallet with no record before its creation is 'new'

payment.description: the x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value for this exact call (USDC on Solana). Leave it out to get the offer: the price, the payee and the network come back as the error content and as _meta['payment-required'].

name: wallet_records
